smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Homestyler
shortDescription: Browser 3D floor planner with rendering. Pro+ starts at $6.80 a month.
longDescription: Homestyler is a cloud 3D floor planner with more than 100,000 free models. The Basic plan is free and includes unlimited 1K rendering. Pro+ starts at $6.80 a month and includes 75 renders each at 2K and 4K plus 180 AI credits a month. Master+ starts at $11.80 a month with unlimited 4K image rendering.
pricingNotes: Basic is free with unlimited 1K rendering. Pro+ starts at $6.80 per month. Master+ starts at $11.80 per month. Team starts at $19.90 per seat per month.
freeTierNotes: Free Basic plan with unlimited 1K rendering.

strength: Homestyler is a browser 3D floor planner with free unlimited 1K rendering and paid higher-resolution renders.
weakness: Pro+ starts at $6.80 per month, and a presentation-resolution render needs that paid allowance or a per-render purchase.
